data.name: Trans Theft Horso
data.detailed_description:
It's out!

Howdy-doody, friends of all genders! Trans Theft Horso is now out, and I hope it will bring hope and gender gladness (GGs). I've been working on this since its title came to me three years ago. I dearly wanted to play the game I imagined when I heard the words 'Trans Theft Horso', but nobody else was making it, so I summoned it into existence myself.

Which of us has never longed to traverse the West, striving for justice, with a skunk on our head for company and protection?


About the Game

Adric Belfonté never wanted to go west, but a small task, picking up their brother's hormones, turns into a wild and western fantasy of crime and adventure!

Explore the bewaffling and dangerous west! Defy the admirals, ride the animals, fight the haters, seek the missing, and discover why the medicine routes dried up. The West is full of friends and enemies, of lobsters and monsters, and the two great gee-gees: horses and gender gladness!

A feverish LGBTQ fantasy adventure, in full colour! Go west, young enby! Have fun, and beware!

data.short_description: A colourful western fantasy adventure, to save trans joy! Adric Belfonte embarks on a happy nightmare into the wild and bewaffling West. Explore the maddening desert, defy the admirals, ride the animals, fight the haters, and save the missing hormones! A feverish wild-west fantasy, in full colour!
data.reviews:
“Oh to experience joy in a hostile world. In this game you just want to quickly help a friend out when you get caught up in a world of glorious absurdity. Side quest after side quest unfolds and pulls you into a meticulously crafted reality all glued together by a precious good: humour. While you are still trying to run that errand you get entangled in comical fights, you break the law, you kill a creature or two, you devour pointless eggs, you make a bunch of frenemies. And while you roam through an effortless abundance of word play and beautifully silly songs you get to reflect on gender identity and gender performance. This game reminds us that, as right wing policies are on the rise, it is a radically political act to create queer joy. Long live gender gladness. The winner of the Most Amazing Award is: Ben Swithen with “Trans Theft Horso””
A MAZE Games and Playful Media Festival
